items.sobreMimSummary:
I am Aster, a Frontend Developer focused on creating performant interfaces and clean architectures. Currently in my 6th semester of Computer Science at UniAmérica, I split my time between code and leading an academic technical community, where I orchestrate collaborative projects and help level up other students.

My interest in programming did not start with theory, but dissecting systems in practice. The gateway was configuring online game servers and reverse engineering for cheat creation. This exploration forced me to understand early on how machine memory works, how to intercept data flows, and how a systems logic operates at a low level. Today, I channel this same analytical curiosity to build secure and robust web applications.

Outside the repositories, I keep my mind sharp studying Mandarin and analyzing competitive esports. To sustain this level of technical demand, I apply non-negotiable discipline in real life: training intensely with the goal of completing an Ironman triathlon. It is this combination of consistency, complex problem solving, and pragmatic execution that I deliver in software engineering.

items.calcSummary: Interactive statistical calculator that crosses 12 demographic filters with official IBGE microdata (2022 Census, 2023 PNAD) to reveal the real probability of finding the ideal partner in Brazil. Real-time calculation, shareable viral card, and complete data audit.
items.soulSummary: Themed memory game remastered in the League of Legends Soul Fighter universe. Rebuilt with React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, featuring 4 combat modes (including Legend with 10 lives and K.O.), hint & peek system, Web Audio API, and Aster Account integration for global ranking.
items.pexSummary: Academic knowledge hub for Computer Science students at Centro Universitário União das Américas - UniAmérica. View system with SPA routing in Vanilla JS, 'Blurple Gamer' design system in dark mode, interactive checklists, dynamic modals for the 17 UN SDGs, and Mobile First responsiveness.
items.demoSummary: Demo mobile application built with React Native.
items.chatbotSummary: Conversational assistant powered by a Heuristic Intent Classifier. Ask questions about Aster, his engineering journey, and projects.
items.studioSummary: Comprehensive Operating System for serious content creators. Centralizes 12 intelligent tools calibrated to your channel's unique voice (Idea Ranking, High-CTR Titles, Retention Hooks, Scripting & Teleprompter, Thumbnail Briefs, AI Humanizer, and Post Scorecard). Built with Astro 7.3, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase Auth/Postgres, and Cloudflare Workers.
items.duoSummary: Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) engineered for smart automation on Duolingo. Features a direct-API XP farming engine, Super Mode activation via JS chunk patching, continuous auto-solver for exercises, sequential lesson progression, and an in-page floating widget.
items.downloaderSummary: Modern hybrid video downloader for Chromium browsers. Pairs a persistent Chrome Side Panel extension with a native yt-dlp + FFmpeg Companion App, supporting up to 4K60 HDR media, authenticated HLS (.m3u8) streams, and native MP3 audio extraction.
